entities.name: Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi

entities.summary: Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi is an Omani diplomat, and politician who has been serving as the foreign minister of Oman since 18 August 2020. He has represented Oman in regional and international meetings, which include the United Nations.
